Explicit positive equilibrium demonstrates sharpness. Standalone rational and trajectory consistency checks passed; finite numerics are supplementary.

value.rationale: At a physically natural predator-invasion transcritical threshold, qualitative neutral stability is insufficient to determine extinction times. The two exact universal amplitudes distinguish slow predator loss from strict exponential decay, determine prey recovery speed and apply without small-initial-density assumptions. These predictions are not numerical curiosities or a routine parameter substitution.
